title: sonar_tracks
description: One tracked target in public.sonar_tracks. A row is one passage through the beam, not a sound event and not a confirmed fish until review_status is confirmed. direction is upstream, downstream, milling, or unknown. species_id is null when the classifier abstains or when the row is a Lowrance import that only has a size class. species_confidence is a 0-1 score, not a calibrated probability unless the model card says so, and is null when no species model ran. source is synthetic, lowrance_log, aris, or split_beam. clip_path, when set, is an object key in the Storage bucket sonar. features is a track summary, not an ARIS frame. review_status defaults to unreviewed. Realtime is enabled on this table. Inserts use the service role.

speed_mps.description: Track speed in metres per second.

clip_path.description: Object key in bucket sonar, or null.

features.description: Track summary. Synthetic rows set synthetic=true and behavior to surface_cluster, school, solitary, or unknown. Lowrance imports set detector, detection_confidence (not a species probability), size_class, bass_candidate, and channel.

source.description: synthetic rows come from the simulator. lowrance_log rows come from a .sl2 or .sl3 import and keep species_id null unless a later step assigns it.
